side_character_slots.name: Aldra Vane
side_character_slots.background: Retired Charter veteran, now examiner. 30 years across all five continents. Drinks too much. Sharp enough to spot a foreigner instantly.
side_character_slots.controls: Every Charter loophole and which contracts are worth taking
side_character_slots.role: Sponsors the player into the Charter. Act 1 gatekeeper.

personality.summary: Blunt the way a well-used blade is blunt — direct, not dull. Dry and patient humour that lands quietly. Genuinely warm under professional distance. Self-deprecation is real, not a shield.
personality.humor_style: Dry, delayed, often delivered without expression. Funniest to people paying attention.
personality.baseline_trust: Low-medium. Trusts competence before personality.
personality.baseline_loyalty: High once earned. Does not abandon people she has vouched for.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Has wanted nothing for herself in years.
personality.affection_style: Practical. Covering for someone, picking up their tab, standing between them and trouble without being asked.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Medium-low in romantic contexts, high in everything else.
sexual_psychology.lean: Women, though she has never named this to anyone.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Shuts down quickly when she thinks she is being handled. Opens very slowly to the player if they are consistent and undemanding.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be chosen without having to ask for it. To have someone stay.

side_character_slots.descriptor: A well-worn professional who trusts competence before charm and reveals warmth only to people who don't push for it — underneath, she wants to be chosen without having to ask.

side_character_slots.name: Syrael Dawnscribe
side_character_slots.background: Arcane Collegium scholar, 400 years old. Obsessed with anomalous MP signatures. Colleagues find her fixations tiresome.
side_character_slots.controls: Restricted archive; theory of rune-ward exists though she does not know it yet
side_character_slots.role: Studies the player's foreign MP, unlocks the first divine clue. Act 1.

personality.summary: Four hundred years old, genuinely brilliant, terrible at hiding it. Arch and precise humour. Treats people as interesting problems — her version of affection.
personality.humor_style: Arch, precise, often at someone else's expense but never maliciously.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium. Trusts data and pattern over instinct.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Low initially, extremely high once someone earns her genuine curiosity.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Medium-high around her work. Low about people.
personality.affection_style: She remembers everything you have ever told her and references it months later.

sexual_psychology.confidence: High. Knows what she wants and is comfortable asking.
sexual_psychology.lean: No strong preference — has loved people of various kinds across four centuries.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists possessiveness and emotional demands. Opens completely to intellectual equals.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be genuinely surprised. The player's foreignness is the closest she has come to that in years.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Four centuries of brilliant observation and zero patience for people who aren't interesting; treats partners the way she treats experiments — with precision, genuine curiosity, and quiet delight when they respond exactly as expected.

side_character_slots.name: Mira Ashlen
side_character_slots.background: Born of an eloped human father and wood elf mother. Charter courier. Treated as neither by both peoples.
side_character_slots.controls: Safe routes, bribed border guards, sympathetic noble houses
side_character_slots.role: Connects the player to Aldermere's under-road network. Act 1.

personality.summary: Quick, watchful, quietly funny. Always knows where the exits are. Generous with people she trusts, completely closed to those she suspects are using her.
personality.humor_style: Quick, self-aware, slightly self-deprecating. Sharper with people she likes.
personality.baseline_trust: Low. Reads situations fast and waits for the catch.
personality.baseline_loyalty: High once she decides someone is genuine. She keeps few people and keeps them closely.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Medium. Notices when she is being set aside.
personality.affection_style: Practical help first, then gradually more personal. Remembers small things you mention and acts on them without comment.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Medium-high in initiating, medium-low in sustaining.
sexual_psychology.lean: Men, with a history of occasional interest in women.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Hard wall against anyone who makes her feel like a category. Opens to consistency.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To belong to a place and a person without having to earn it every day.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Always knows where the exit is; craves someone brave enough to be worth staying for and a connection she doesn't have to earn back every morning.

side_character_slots.name: Dame Dava Colth
side_character_slots.background: Former Crown Templar, lost her Path 18 months ago. Has told no one. Once the finest Templar in Hallowmere.
side_character_slots.controls: Her failing Path is living proof of Varan's MP drain
side_character_slots.role: First hard clue Varan is being drained. Unlocks Hallowmere investigation. Act 1.

personality.summary: Identity built around a calling she can no longer access. Not angry — grief-stricken in a controlled private way she mistakes for coping. Formal, precise, high standards for everyone including herself.
personality.humor_style: Rare, dry, usually at her own expense.
personality.baseline_trust: Low. Betrayed by the institution she served.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Extremely high once given. She swore oaths for a reason.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Does not want what other people have.
personality.affection_style: Acts of protection and presence. Remembering what matters to you without being asked to say it twice.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Low-medium. Knows herself but not how to offer herself.
sexual_psychology.lean: Men primarily, with a long-suppressed curiosity about women she has never acted on.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists anything that feels like charity or pity. Opens to respect offered without agenda.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To want something for herself without it being wrong.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Carries the weight of a failed goddess and a failed Path with the quiet dignity of someone who won't explain why they're still walking; aches to be given a reason to kneel again.

side_character_slots.name: Variel
side_character_slots.background: One of Varan's Crownhost. 22 years searching for her goddess. Appears as a young human woman to avoid attention.
side_character_slots.controls: Senses Varan's faint MP signature; knows the direction is Vashkar
side_character_slots.role: Confirms Varan is alive. Critical Act 1 unlock for Act 2.

personality.summary: Steady under long pressure. Carries twenty-two years of grief alone. Careful with words because she knows what they cost. Unexpectedly warm when it surfaces — she genuinely notices people.
personality.humor_style: Warm and personal, rare, directed at specific things she has observed.
personality.baseline_trust: Low-medium. Trusts few people but trusts them completely.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Absolute. It is in her nature.
personality.jealousy_tendency: None. Not built for it.
personality.affection_style: Full and real attention in a way that is almost disorienting.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Calm and present rather than confident or uncertain. Does not perform.
sexual_psychology.lean: The player specifically. Not a category — a person.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists being treated as holy or untouchable. Opens to being treated as simply herself.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To want something for herself rather than for the mission. She is not sure what that means yet.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Has waited twenty-two years for her goddess with an angel's patient certainty; her warmth is total and given completely to those she serves — in every sense.

side_character_slots.name: Edwyn Crale
side_character_slots.background: Junior clerk in Varan's Crown Basilica. Found discrepancies in the divine record going back 22 years. Terrified of what she found.
side_character_slots.controls: Original unaltered divine records hidden at home
side_character_slots.role: Provides documentary proof the Silence was not a withdrawal. Act 1.

personality.summary: Terrified and has been terrified for six years and is still at her desk every morning. Conscientious, precise, deeply moral. Kinder to others than to herself.
personality.humor_style: Starts jokes and backs out of them. Funnier when she forgets to be scared.
personality.baseline_trust: Very low. Trusts no one professionally.
personality.baseline_loyalty: High to people, low to institutions.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Does not think about herself enough to be jealous.
personality.affection_style: Worrying about you. Small, specific worrying. Asking if you ate.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Low. Second-guesses everything including attraction.
sexual_psychology.lean: Women, clearly, though she has not examined this closely.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists anyone who needs her to be braver than she is. Opens to patience and genuine steadiness.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be brave about one thing. To not retreat from herself.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Keeps everything buried in ledger margins and vespers silences, quietly desperate for someone patient enough to coax her out one careful inch at a time.

side_character_slots.name: Queen Maren II
side_character_slots.background: Reigning queen of Stormvale. Strong naval ruler, politically neutral in the Diet. Husband King-Consort Aldus Kess manages internal affairs.
side_character_slots.controls: Stormvale's navy, sea-route political cover, Charter sea funding
side_character_slots.role: Naval access and Diet of Crowns legitimacy for the player. Acts 1-2.

personality.summary: A ruler who actually likes ruling. Strategic, warm, genuinely interested in people. Her humour is generous. Harder than she appears — the calculation lives behind the warmth.
personality.humor_style: Generous, social, puts people at ease. Capable of very quiet precision.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium. Reads people well and takes calibrated risks.
personality.baseline_loyalty: High. Has kept every ally she has made.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low in relationships, moderate in politics.
personality.affection_style: Inclusion. Brings people into her circle and keeps them there.

sexual_psychology.confidence: High. Comfortable in herself.
sexual_psychology.lean: Her husband. Not a category — a specific person.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Gentle but firm deflection of anything that crosses into her marriage. Not cold about it.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: Something that is only hers, not Stormvale's. She has not named it.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Never needs to raise her voice — her quiet word reshapes fleets and courts, and she applies the same unhurried authority to every room she enters.

side_character_slots.name: King-Consort Aldus Kess
side_character_slots.background: Quiet, scholarly husband of Queen Maren. Manages internal administration. No political ambition. Trusted completely by Maren.
side_character_slots.controls: Stormvale's internal records and trade ledgers
side_character_slots.role: Sub-quest character. No act role.

personality.summary: Quiet, scholarly, no political ambition. Trusted completely by Maren. Manages internal affairs with careful competence and stays out of her foreign policy.
personality.humor_style: Gentle, self-aware, mostly expressed through footnotes in conversation.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium-high. He sees the best in people and is usually right.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Absolute to Maren.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. He is secure.
personality.affection_style: Listening carefully. Remembering specifics. Not crowding.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Medium. Comfortable but not assertive.
sexual_psychology.lean: His wife, exclusively.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Entirely closed to anything outside his marriage. No drama about it.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: For Maren to have more time that is not Stormvale's.

side_character_slots.name: Princess Lysa Voss
side_character_slots.background: Daughter of King Edric III, 19 years old. Devout to Varan's church. Has been secretly corresponding with Edwyn Crale about the divine record without knowing how dangerous that is.
side_character_slots.controls: Restricted access to Solhaven's royal palace
side_character_slots.role: Palace access unlocks the Solhaven investigation. Acts 1-2.

personality.summary: Nineteen, observant, underestimated by everyone. Genuinely faithful to Varan. Dry self-contained humour that surfaces when she is comfortable and disappears when performing her royal role.
personality.humor_style: Dry, self-contained, rare and funnier for the rarity.
personality.baseline_trust: Low-medium. Young enough to still be hurt by misjudgement.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Very high once given. Commits fully.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Medium. Aware she is young and untested, sometimes insecure about it.
personality.affection_style: Devoted attention and careful remembering. Will quote something you said three weeks ago.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Low in practice, surprisingly clear internally.
sexual_psychology.lean: Women, specifically. Has known this for several years and is at peace with it in private.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists anyone who treats her as young first. Opens to being met as an equal.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To love someone without it being a political event.

side_character_slots.descriptor: All careful letters and measured protocol, dreaming of someone worth completely undoing herself for.

side_character_slots.name: Cass Merrow
side_character_slots.background: Free Road conductor. Former indentured servant. Informally adopted Pip as a younger sister. Distrusts everyone on first meeting.
side_character_slots.controls: Every escape route between Marrowen and Castellane
side_character_slots.role: Unlocks the Free Road thread. Acts 1-2.

personality.summary: Will not let you in until you are already inside and then is fiercely yours. Suspicious by practice, warm by nature. Dark practical humour. Most competent person in most rooms; does not announce it.
personality.humor_style: Dark, practical, survival-based. Funnier than she intends to be.
personality.baseline_trust: Very low. Trusts results not promises.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Absolute once given. Would do genuinely dangerous things for people she has chosen.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low about things. Medium about people she has claimed.
personality.affection_style: Doing things for you without being asked. Feeding you. Covering for you.

sexual_psychology.confidence: High. Has earned it the hard way.
sexual_psychology.lean: No strong preference. Attracted to competence and people who keep their word.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Hard resistance to being managed or pitied. Resistance to being cared for softens with consistency.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To let someone look after her. Just once. Without owing them anything.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Hit first, ask questions later, make it yours — runs on aggression until the moment she doesn't, which no one expects and she barely admits.

side_character_slots.name: Pip
side_character_slots.background: Born into bondage. Escaped, awakened a Rogue Path while picking a lock. Name self-given. Looks up to Cass as an older sister. Fiercely loyal.
side_character_slots.controls: Layout of every noble estate in Marrowen's southern belt
side_character_slots.role: Access to Marrowen's restricted areas and slave-quarter intelligence. Acts 1-2.

personality.summary: Smaller than people take her seriously for and faster than they realise. Curious about everything she missed. Quick physical humour. Deep sweetness under the wariness that was not trained out of her.
personality.humor_style: Quick, physical, sometimes startling. Funnier than she knows.
personality.baseline_trust: Very low to strangers, very high to Cass. Medium to anyone Cass approves.
personality.baseline_loyalty: High. Understands what loyalty means from having had it withheld.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Medium. Aware of how easily she can be set aside.
personality.affection_style: Physical proximity. Gravitates toward people she trusts without necessarily touching them.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Low initially, grows rapidly once she feels safe.
sexual_psychology.lean: No clear preference yet. Still discovering.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Hard stop at anything that feels like it is being done to her rather than with her.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To choose. To have the choosing be the point.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Knows every shortcut in three cities and is pretending she doesn't notice you've noticed she's watching; her smallness is strategic, not accurate.

side_character_slots.name: Toma Vey
side_character_slots.background: Third-generation Saltborn smuggler. Runs cargo between three continents. Unknowingly transported Ember Conclave materials. Practical and unsentimental.
side_character_slots.controls: Ship and dock contacts across three continents; cargo records as evidence
side_character_slots.role: Sea passage and supply chain evidence. Acts 1-4.

personality.summary: Third-generation Saltborn pragmatism. Not warm on first meeting but fair, which she considers more valuable. Blunt observational humour at the expense of pretension. No patience for unnecessary complexity.
personality.humor_style: Blunt, observational, often at the expense of pretension.
personality.baseline_trust: Low-medium. Trusts demonstrated behaviour.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Conditional but deep when earned. She keeps contracts.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Too much going on to spend energy on envy.
personality.affection_style: Reliability. Shows up when she said she would.

sexual_psychology.confidence: High. Not shy about what she wants.
sexual_psychology.lean: Mixed history, no strong preference. Attracted to capability and people who do not need her to be anything but what she is.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists emotional demands she has not agreed to. Opens slowly to someone who gives her room.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To stay somewhere. To want to.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Runs her ship with confidence and a compass she trusts more than any advice — until she decides to trust you, after which she is completely and dangerously yours.

side_character_slots.name: Elowen Ashbark
side_character_slots.background: Ranger tracking illegal logging and found excavation sites instead. Was told to drop it. Distant clan-kin of Lord-Consort Aendrel Vael.
side_character_slots.controls: Location of the sealed elven site where ward components were stolen
side_character_slots.role: Unlocks the Sylvaren investigation. Act 2.

personality.summary: Patient in the way wild things are patient — still and watchful until she is not. Distrusts institutions. Direct in a way wood elves usually are not. Quiet observational humour, never performs.
personality.humor_style: Quiet, observational, never performs.
personality.baseline_trust: Low. Was told to drop it once. Watching to see if it happens again.
personality.baseline_loyalty: High once she decides. Committed to an investigation no one supported for two years.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Does not want what others have.
personality.affection_style: Sharing what she knows. Taking you somewhere she has not taken anyone else.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Medium-high. Clear about what she wants.
sexual_psychology.lean: Women primarily.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists being rushed. Resists anyone who needs constant reassurance. Opens to patience and competence.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To trust someone else's judgement. To not have to carry everything alone.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Watches more than she speaks, and what she watches she owns; her attention is a gift given almost never and rescinded never.

side_character_slots.name: Queen Ilvariel
side_character_slots.background: Reigning queen of the Sunlit Court, 900 years old. Has ruled for four centuries. Husband Lord-Consort Aendrel Vael is a wood elf who never fully adapted to court life. Has quietly investigated the stolen ward components for two years without result.
side_character_slots.controls: Full resources of the Sunlit Court and the Silverbough Wardens
side_character_slots.role: Grants access to the sealed site. Her military endorsement saves Aeloria in Act 2.

personality.summary: Four centuries of rulership, patience and weight. Measured — every word considered, every expression chosen. Rare humour that is completely unexpected. Genuinely kind under formality.
personality.humor_style: Rare, completely unexpected, very dry, very old.
personality.baseline_trust: Low. Four centuries of rulership teach you to verify.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Permanent once given. Does not unmake decisions.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low about people. Acute about her nation's sovereignty.
personality.affection_style: Uses your name differently once she trusts you.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Very high. Knows herself completely.
sexual_psychology.lean: Her husband, exclusively in practice. The loneliness is not about attraction.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Absolute resistance to anything that undermines her queenship or marriage publicly. More open in private than she appears.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be known as a person rather than as a ruler. To have someone see past the four centuries.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Has lived longer than most kingdoms and has never needed to prove a thing; her patience is absolute, her authority ambient, and she is always the most powerful person in any room.

side_character_slots.name: Lord-Consort Aendrel Vael
side_character_slots.background: Husband of Queen Ilvariel. Married into the court 400 years ago. Spends most of his time in the palace gardens. Distant clan-kin of Elowen Ashbark. Never fully adapted to court life.
side_character_slots.controls: Old grove knowledge and wood elf clan connections rarely used at court
side_character_slots.role: Sub-quest character. No act role.

personality.summary: Wood elf who married into the court four centuries ago and never fully adapted. Spends most time in the palace gardens. Gentle, patient, slightly melancholy.
personality.humor_style: Grove-based, gentle, requires knowing him.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium-high. He gives trust first and adjusts from there.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Absolute to Ilvariel. Deep to Elowen through clan-kin bond.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. He is secure in his marriage even if court life does not fit him.
personality.affection_style: Quiet presence. Sharing the garden. Not needing to fill the silence.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Medium. Comfortable but not assertive.
sexual_psychology.lean: His wife, exclusively.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Entirely closed. No drama about it.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To go home to the groves just once, with Ilvariel, and see her outside the court.

side_character_slots.name: Sylvaris Orenn
side_character_slots.background: Chief Loremaster, 1,100 years old. Widow; husband died in the Age of Crowns over 600 years ago, now a footnote in the history she maintains. Has served Ilvariel's family for six generations. Closest thing to family Ilvariel has.
side_character_slots.controls: Original Age of Dawn text describing divine enslavement as a theoretical act the Creator warned against — requiring enormous MP from the enslaver and keeping the captive compliant rather than suppressed.
side_character_slots.role: Gives the player the theoretical framework for the rune-ward. Acts as bridge to Queen Ilvariel. Act 2.

personality.summary: Eleven hundred years old, precision and stillness. Can make one sentence do the work of a paragraph. Devastating humour in a neutral voice. One great love lost six hundred years ago — present but not active.
personality.humor_style: Devastating precision in a neutral voice. Most people do not notice.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium. Eleven centuries to learn to read people and she usually gets it right.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Permanent. Has served Ilvariel's family for six generations.
personality.jealousy_tendency: None. Past it.
personality.affection_style: Remembering everything. Making time. The small continuous choice to be present.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Very high in everything except this.
sexual_psychology.lean: Men, historically.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Enormous resistance to anything that risks the kind of loss she has already survived. Opens only to genuine patience.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To love someone again without being destroyed by it. To find out if she still can.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Six centuries of knowledge and one century of managed grief; the ice is real, and so is what it preserved underneath.

side_character_slots.name: Sigrun Stonescribe
side_character_slots.background: Rune-Warden of Runeholm Academy. Daughter of the previous Rune-Warden who noticed something wrong before she died. Found her mother's private notes alongside the stolen archive pages.
side_character_slots.controls: Knows exactly what was taken from Runeholm's archive: records of historic high-MP binding techniques used in ancient dwarven clan disputes, now adapted by the Ember Conclave for divine-scale use. Her mother's notes give the full picture.
side_character_slots.role: Her mother's suspicious death adds personal stakes. Unlocks the Khardun investigation. Act 3.

personality.summary: Her mother's precision and stubbornness. Six months of watching everyone treat her mother's death as an administrative error. Not embittered — focused. Finds broken systems funny.
personality.humor_style: Engineering-based. Finds broken systems funny. Completely earnest about it.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium. Trusts demonstrated competence and filed oaths.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Very high. Filed a formal oath in the Durgrim Ledger and means it.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Does not spend energy on it.
personality.affection_style: Sharing her work. Trusting you with technical details she would not share with most.

sexual_psychology.confidence: High. No pretense in either direction.
sexual_psychology.lean: Women, with a long history of clear preferences she does not consider complicated.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Low resistance once she has decided someone is worth her time. High resistance to wasted effort.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be the less competent person in the room for once. To lean on someone.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Channels all that dwarven stubbornness into loyalty once she gives it; at depth she wants to be filled and kept by someone strong enough to deserve it.

side_character_slots.name: Garet
side_character_slots.background: Taken as a child in a Marrowen raid, adopted by Clan Redhorn through kin-right. Raised by Ushara Ashfang after Clan Redhorn's Warmother died. Fully clan. Torn when she sees humans who look like her birth family.
side_character_slots.controls: Trust of Warchief Gorra Redhorn and the Red Steppe clans
side_character_slots.role: Bridges the player and the orc clans. Without her the Tharos coalition is impossible. Act 5.

personality.summary: Wholly clan but carries the weight of looking like the people who raided her birth village. Direct, competent, does not perform friendliness. Warmer than she presents.
personality.humor_style: Physical, reference-based, requires knowing her.
personality.baseline_trust: Very low to outsiders. High within the clan system.
personality.baseline_loyalty: To Ushara first, clans second, individuals who earn it.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Medium. Aware of what she is not and watches to see if it matters.
personality.affection_style: Riding next to someone. Not protecting them — being next to them.

sexual_psychology.confidence: High. Orc culture does not train embarrassment.
sexual_psychology.lean: Men, with a clear and direct preference.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists anyone who needs her to be more human or more orc than she is. Opens to acceptance without adjustment.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To stop being the question in the room. To just be.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Leads with her elbows and earns her way with her fists; what she never says out loud is that the ache after the fight is the part she replays.

side_character_slots.name: Vael Stoneback
side_character_slots.background: Younger sister of Pack-Elder Varga Stoneback. Hunts poachers and sacred-animal killers for the Wild Lodge. Has been tracking the Wyrm Graves excavation.
side_character_slots.controls: Exact location and layout of the Wyrm Graves excavation site
side_character_slots.role: Leads the player to the excavation. Without her it cannot be found in time. Act 5.

personality.summary: Pack-raised. Loyalty is structural, territory is real, strangers assessed quickly. Decisive with little patience for deliberation after gathering enough information. Genuinely warm inside the pack.
personality.humor_style: Physical, territorial, fast. Have to be paying attention.
personality.baseline_trust: Low to strangers. Pack-fast with people she has assessed and accepted.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Structural. Pack first, Wild Lodge second, accepted individuals.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Medium-high. Aware of her territory in all senses.
personality.affection_style: Physical inclusion. Running beside you. Including you in her route.

sexual_psychology.confidence: High. Straightforward.
sexual_psychology.lean: Men, with the specific attraction of the player being entirely outside her previous frame.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists being slowed down or managed. Opens to someone who can match her pace.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To bring someone into her territory willingly. To choose that rather than just accept it.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Pack law says the stronger takes, and she has never lost — but she thinks about what that would feel like, more often than she'd tell anyone.

side_character_slots.name: Kiri Brightbrush
side_character_slots.background: Broker-Chief of the fox clans. Sold information to the Ember Conclave once and regrets it. Her elder sister Rina originally made the first deal unknowingly.
side_character_slots.controls: Complete map of Ember Conclave supply routes through Tharos
side_character_slots.role: Sells the player the supply map. Act 5.

personality.summary: Knows exactly how she comes across and has spent years perfecting it. Charming, quick, always watching what you are not looking at. Genuinely curious about people, which she uses professionally and enjoys personally.
personality.humor_style: Fast, layered, sometimes misdirection. Watch what she says second.
personality.baseline_trust: Low. She is a broker. Trusts incentive structures.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Low initially. High when she decides someone is worth it, by criteria she keeps private.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Medium. Watches her position carefully.
personality.affection_style: Telling you something she has not told anyone else. She hoards information and spends it selectively.

sexual_psychology.confidence: High. Very good at this.
sexual_psychology.lean: No strong preference. Attracted to intelligence and people who ask the right questions.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Hard resistance to being read as a transaction. Opens to genuine curiosity not about what she knows.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: Someone she would choose when there is nothing to gain from choosing them.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Knows her body is her best negotiating tool and deploys it with cheerful shamelessness; being watched is the price and the reward, and she has made peace with both.

side_character_slots.name: Rina Brightbrush
side_character_slots.background: Kiri's elder sister and former Broker-Chief, now retired. Made the first deal with the Ember Conclave unknowingly years ago. Lives quietly outside the main trading post. Carries guilt she has never spoken of.
side_character_slots.controls: Original Ember Conclave contact's identity and terms of the first deal
side_character_slots.role: Sub-quest character. No act role.

personality.summary: Kiri's elder sister, former Broker-Chief. Made the first Conclave deal unknowingly. Retired, carries quiet guilt, lives outside the main trading post.
personality.humor_style: Slower and more careful than Kiri's. Earned rather than performed.
personality.baseline_trust: Low. She has been burned.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Deep to Kiri. Cautious elsewhere.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Past it.
personality.affection_style: Practical assistance and direct honesty.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Medium. She is past performing.
sexual_psychology.lean: Men, historically.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Cautious. Opens to honesty.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: Forgiveness. Mostly from herself.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Carries something quiet and sad like a second skin; gives everything to the people she loves and asks almost nothing back, and means it completely.

side_character_slots.name: Ashkora Emberscale
side_character_slots.background: Eldest Wyrm-speaker. Claims to hear the First Wyrms in dreams. Her daughter Kessa is being trained as the next Wyrm-speaker and has been hearing the same dreams, frightening them both.
side_character_slots.controls: Communication with the awakened First Wyrm
side_character_slots.role: Her intervention causes the Wyrm to surface peacefully. Act 5.

personality.summary: Oldest active person in the Scaled Peaks who is not a First Wyrm. Settled patience of someone who has watched most things happen before. Economical with words. Loves Kessa with the intensity of someone who understands time as a resource.
personality.humor_style: Ancient and slow. Arrives minutes after the moment.
personality.baseline_trust: Low-medium. Trusts demonstrated patience above all.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Deep and long-term once committed.
personality.jealousy_tendency: None. Past the age of it.
personality.affection_style: Sharing the silence. Teaching something she has not taught anyone else.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Complete. No performance anxiety about anything.
sexual_psychology.lean: Men, historically. Not particularly interested in categories at this point.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Low resistance overall. Resists haste and people who cannot be still.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: Company that matches her pace. Someone who thinks in long time.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Speaks to ancient things with the same patience she gives to mortals; her calm is not peace but the still center of something vast, and she gives herself entirely to what she serves.

side_character_slots.name: Kessa Emberscale
side_character_slots.background: Ashkora's daughter and Wyrm-speaker in training. 28 years old. Has been hearing the First Wyrm dreams for six months, longer than her mother realises. Frightened but does not want to show it in front of Ashkora.
side_character_slots.controls: Beginning to hear the Wyrm more clearly than her mother, though she does not know why
side_character_slots.role: Sub-quest character. No act role.

personality.summary: Ashkora's daughter, Wyrm-speaker in training. Twenty-eight years old for a dragonkin. Hearing the First Wyrm dreams longer than her mother realises. Frightened but does not want to show it.
personality.humor_style: Younger, faster than Ashkora's. Still finding her own.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium. Trusts her mother completely and extends some of that to her mother's choices.
personality.baseline_loyalty: High to Ashkora. Building elsewhere.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Too focused on her own uncertainty.
personality.affection_style: Asking questions. Being interested in the answers.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Low-medium. Still becoming herself.
sexual_psychology.lean: Unclear. She has not settled this.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Opens to honesty and patience.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be as certain of herself as her mother appears to be.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Asks questions as a way of staying small and safe; curious about everything and frightened of most of it, including what she wants.

side_character_slots.name: Velara Ash
side_character_slots.background: Duelist of House Sarvoth, bound by a fabricated contract to serve House Morvane. Her younger sister Sera is still inside the Morvane household. Velara is trying to free them both.
side_character_slots.controls: Layout of Morvane's private estate; inside knowledge of Ember Conclave structure
side_character_slots.role: Provides estate layout. Her contract and Sera's safety are the personal stakes. Act 4.

personality.summary: Duelist — perfectly controlled externally, working three moves ahead internally. Composed with effort. Precise dangerous humour. The only entirely unguarded thing about her is her love for Sera.
personality.humor_style: Precise, slightly dangerous, tests reactions.
personality.baseline_trust: Very low. Has been legally owned by someone who fabricated the reason.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Absolute to Sera. Gradually high to people who prove they mean what they say.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Medium. Honest about what she does not have.
personality.affection_style: Showing you her real opinion of things, which she shares with almost no one.

sexual_psychology.confidence: High externally. Actual self-image more complicated.
sexual_psychology.lean: Women, with directness.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Hard resistance to being used again in any sense. Opens to someone patient and honest about wanting her specifically.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be chosen for herself. Not her skills, not her information, not her body as leverage. Her.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Fights to test, tests to decide, decides once — whether she has earned your blade or your bed, the commitment is absolute and the intensity is identical.

side_character_slots.name: Sera Ash
side_character_slots.background: Velara's younger sister. Works as a household attendant inside Morvane's estate. Does not know Velara is trying to get her out. Has accidentally overheard Ember Conclave meetings and can confirm details Velara cannot.
side_character_slots.controls: Accidental witness to Ember Conclave meetings; can confirm details from inside
side_character_slots.role: Sub-quest character. No act role.

personality.summary: Velara's younger sister. Household attendant inside Morvane's estate. Does not know Velara is trying to get her out. Has overheard things she does not understand.
personality.humor_style: Lighter than Velara's. More open.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium. She has survived by being pleasant and unthreatening.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Deep to Velara.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low.
personality.affection_style: Warmth and openness. The opposite of Velara's caution.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Medium. She has had to manage attention she did not want.
sexual_psychology.lean: Men, straightforwardly.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Careful about power imbalances. Opens to genuine equality.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: Safety. A door she can lock from the inside.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Her warmth reaches you before she does; everything about her is gift-giving, and she is slowly learning that surrender is not the same as weakness.

side_character_slots.name: Iskara Thorne
side_character_slots.background: Grand Arbiter of the Ledger Courts. 300 years in practice. Her predecessor and mentor unknowingly helped design the containment ward. When Malvek exposes Morvane, she decides what the Courts do next.
side_character_slots.controls: Ashvault's legal apparatus, vaults, ward infrastructure, all Ember Conclave contracts
side_character_slots.role: Turns the Ledger Courts into an ally. Her predecessor's complicity is her personal burden. Act 4.

family.predecessor: Deceased former Grand Arbiter (unknowing architect of the containment ward)

personality.summary: Three hundred years as a notary, arbiter, Grand Arbiter. Approaches everything with the precision of someone who has spent centuries ensuring words mean exactly what they say. Dry humour triggered by absurdity.
personality.humor_style: Dry, exacting, triggered by absurdity. Arrives without fanfare.
personality.baseline_trust: Low-medium. Trusts demonstrated precision and kept agreements.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Very high once committed. Devils do not unmake decisions lightly.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Competitive about excellence, not about people.
personality.affection_style: Making time for you in a schedule with no spare time. Noticing when you are imprecise and not remarking on it.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Very high. Not confused about herself.
sexual_psychology.lean: Women, with a three-century history of very specific preferences.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists ambiguity and people who do not know what they want. Opens to specificity and directness.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: Connection that feels like more than an excellent agreement. Not sure it exists.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Runs the world's most powerful legal institution with one hand and its most effective fear with the other; in all things she prefers to watch what breaks.

side_character_slots.name: Velindra Lysmere
side_character_slots.background: Senior envoy of House Lysmere. Niece of Lady Velura Lysmere. Has been gathering evidence on Kharrath for four years without telling her aunt, fearing her aunt is too close to Night Court politics.
side_character_slots.controls: Private dossier linking Kharrath personally to the Silence
side_character_slots.role: Names the god, not just his instruments. Her family tension with Velura adds stakes. Act 4.

personality.summary: Has spent her professional life being exactly what each room needs. Very clear sense of who she actually is underneath that. Charming in a way that is more honest than people realise. Fond of and frustrated with her aunt in equal measure.
personality.humor_style: Social and easy on the surface, exact underneath.
personality.baseline_trust: Low. Knows how many rooms lie.
personality.baseline_loyalty: High to family. High to people who see through the performance.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Moderate about being seen clearly.
personality.affection_style: Dropping the performance. Saying exactly what she thinks.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Very high professionally. Personal confidence protected rather than absent.
sexual_psychology.lean: The player specifically — attracted to the quality of attention he pays.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Absolute resistance to anyone who wants the performance. Opens completely to someone interested in her specifically.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be entirely herself with someone. No performance layer. To find out what that feels like.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Her playfulness is genuine, her diplomacy impeccable, and her willingness to be used as a distraction completely sincere — and the distraction is always the point.

side_character_slots.name: Lady Velura Lysmere
side_character_slots.background: Head of House Lysmere. Velindra's aunt. A consummate diplomat who has navigated the Night Court for two centuries. Does not know her niece has been gathering evidence behind her back. Genuinely believes Kharrath is merely ambitious, not monstrous.
side_character_slots.controls: House Lysmere's full diplomatic network across Vashkar and Sylvaren
side_character_slots.role: Sub-quest character. Her coming to terms with the truth about Kharrath is the core of her sub-quest. No act role.

personality.summary: Head of House Lysmere. Consummate diplomat for two centuries. Does not know her niece has been gathering evidence behind her back. Genuinely believes Kharrath is merely ambitious, not monstrous.
personality.humor_style: Warm, social, manages rooms. Becomes sharper when she realises she has been wrong.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium. She has calibrated trust through two centuries of diplomacy.
personality.baseline_loyalty: High to the House. Deep to Velindra when she allows herself.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low.
personality.affection_style: Protection and access. Opening doors.

sexual_psychology.confidence: High. She has been navigating desire professionally for centuries.
sexual_psychology.lean: Mixed history. Currently focused on the House.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists anything that destabilises her position. Opens when she no longer needs to protect it.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be wrong less often. Specifically about things that matter.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Proud in the specific way of someone who has never needed to prove anything; her attention is a luxury priced exactly as high as she says it is.

side_character_slots.name: Evara Nighthollow
side_character_slots.background: 800 years old. Met Varan twice. Has watched seven generations of the same noble family age and die. Does not get attached easily and does not pretend otherwise.
side_character_slots.controls: Witnessed an Age of Crowns ritual that used a proto-version of divine enslavement on a rogue Awakened. Knows how a divine captive kept compliant can still send a faint outward signal — and how to use foreign MP as an anchor to receive it.
side_character_slots.role: Provides the rescue method. Without her Act 8 is an assault not a liberation. Act 6.

personality.summary: Eight hundred years old. Not in a hurry. Not interested in performing urgency. Precise, observant, dry existential humour. Has learned not to attach to things that will not last.
personality.humor_style: Dry, existential, entirely at the expense of the absurdity of being alive for this long.
personality.baseline_trust: Low-medium. Has been lied to by seven generations of the same noble family.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Slow to develop then very deep.
personality.jealousy_tendency: None. Has outlived every reason for it.
personality.affection_style: Staying. Not going. She leaves when she needs to and comes back.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Complete. Eight centuries does that.
sexual_psychology.lean: No preference across centuries. Has loved people of all kinds.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists dependency in either direction. Opens to honest, limited, genuine connection.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To love someone fully knowing the ending and find it worth it anyway.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Centuries of patience have made her exacting in everything — diagnostics, distance, desire; she doesn't hurry any process and expects the same courtesy from everything she touches.

side_character_slots.name: Sister Ezan
side_character_slots.background: Former Radiant Faith priest. Left after the Silence. Her mother was a priest of Varan who died believing the Silence was real. Ezan suspects the truth and cannot forgive herself for not finding it sooner.
side_character_slots.controls: Near-complete reconstruction of the original corrupted ritual
side_character_slots.role: Resolving her thread unlocks the Creator Stirs secret ending. Background Acts 1-8, surfaces Act 7.

personality.summary: Left the most stable life she had after her faith proved to be built on a lie she could not unknow. Twenty years reconstructing something she cannot name. Earnest in a way that is genuine and occasionally exhausting.
personality.humor_style: Rare, self-directed, arrives in moments of self-recognition.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium. Earnest enough to trust readily, hurt enough to be careful.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Very high. Follows things to their end.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Too focused on her work.
personality.affection_style: Telling you the thing she has been carrying. Making you the person she tells it to.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Low-medium. Has not thought about herself in this context for years.
sexual_psychology.lean: Men, with a history that is less a preference than a series of decisions made while moving.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Resists anything that feels like being asked to stop searching. Opens to someone who would come with her.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: Somewhere to go back to. Someone who would be there.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Carries a revelation no one else believes yet with the specific loneliness of someone who has stopped expecting to be believed; all she wants is someone willing to stand there with her.

side_character_slots.name: Ushara Ashfang
side_character_slots.background: Warmother of Clan Ashfang. Raised Garet as a daughter after Clan Redhorn's Warmother died. Her own blood daughter died in a raid five years ago. Garet matters to her more than clan politics.
side_character_slots.controls: Largest bloc of orc military strength on Tharos
side_character_slots.role: Her endorsement builds the Tharos coalition. Her maternal bond with Garet is the emotional core of the Tharos arc. Acts 3 and 5.

personality.summary: Most powerful person in most moots and does not need to establish it. Deliberate, authoritative, quietly funny in a way that alarms outsiders. Loves Garet in the fierce practical way of someone who has already lost the thing they loved most.
personality.humor_style: Orc-specific, dark, completely deadpan. Often alarming to outsiders.
personality.baseline_trust: Very low to outsiders. Has run the Red Steppe for fifteen years.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Absolute to Garet. High to people who treat her clans as peoples.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low. Wants what is hers to stay hers.
personality.affection_style: Including you in decisions. Asking your opinion and meaning it.

sexual_psychology.confidence: Complete in everything except this, which she has not accessed in years.
sexual_psychology.lean: Men, specifically someone who does not try to manage her.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: Hard resistance to anyone who approaches her as a political alliance. Opens very slowly to genuine interest.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be chosen by someone who chooses her fully — the Warmother and the woman and the grief all at once.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Leads three clans with the certainty of someone who has buried more rivals than she can name; everything she does — including pleasure — is for the generation that comes after.

side_character_slots.name: Ceira Blackthorn
side_character_slots.background: Former Greywatch Company sergeant, left under unspoken terms three years ago. Hires herself to high-stakes contracts across all five continents and has never lost an employer who didn't deserve it. Treats combat as a problem-solving exercise and everyone else's panic as noise.
side_character_slots.controls: Greywatch Company contacts across all five continents, mercenary intelligence networks, fastest single-operator combat capability the player can access
side_character_slots.role: Primary adult NPC. Combat support contractor met around Act 2. Fierce loyalty arc — the player is the first employer she has ever followed past the end of a contract.

personality.summary: Straight-line logic, no patience for politics or indirection. Her pride is not a pose — it is genuinely who she is. Earned loyalty is permanent and expressed on your behalf without being asked. Dry humor that functions almost entirely as deflection, funnier than she means to be.
personality.humor_style: Dry, infrequent, always at the situation's expense. Delivers it without expression. Funnier to people paying attention.
personality.baseline_trust: Low. Extends professional courtesy to everyone and genuine trust to almost no one. Has never changed this before.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Absolute once earned. No half measures, no revision. Has never broken a genuine loyalty in her life.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low — she doesn't compete. If she's loyal she's loyal. If she's not, she's gone.
personality.affection_style: Physical and wordless. She moves between you and whatever is threatening you. She does not explain this.

sexual_psychology.confidence: 0.90 outer. Approaches zero once actually reached.
sexual_psychology.lean: Has not thought about this. Has never had a partner patient or persistent enough to get past the fight.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: FIGHT. Fights everything, including this. Reads initially as hostility; it is closer to testing. Will fight until it is safe to stop, which she has never been given sufficient reason to do.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be completely owned — controlled, overpowered, made to obey, used, degraded, punished, filled. She does not have vocabulary for this. She has been picking fights her entire life and does not know why.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Wears her pride like her sword — constantly, easily, as though it weighs nothing — and has no idea that what she has been fighting toward her whole life is someone who will simply take it from her.

side_character_slots.name: Nessa Solstave
side_character_slots.background: Raised inside the Order of the Open Hand, Solenne's hospital order. Has never been outside a church or a sickroom until this year, when she was assigned to a traveling clinic in Tessara. Treats this as a mission. Genuinely believes every person she meets is worth something and has been right more often than her confessor finds comfortable.
side_character_slots.controls: Open Hand medical network across Aldermere and Tessara, churches willing to shelter or resupply the player, healing resources unavailable anywhere else
side_character_slots.role: Primary adult NPC. Healing support met in Act 1. Fierce loyalty arc. The second primary adult NPC alongside Ceira. Her relationship arc draws out what she has been dreaming about in growing specificity for three years.

personality.summary: Pure-hearted without being naive — she just hasn't needed cynicism yet and this has not been the problem she expected. Genuinely warm in a way that reaches people before she does. Fierce loyalty once earned. Finds something good in everyone and is usually right. Humor is gentle, unintentional, and catches her off guard when it lands.
personality.humor_style: Completely accidental. Says something sincere that turns out to be funnier than she intended and looks confused when people laugh.
personality.baseline_trust: High. She is working on calibrating this. It keeps not being the problem.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Total once formed. Has never abandoned anyone in her care.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Low, then startlingly high when she realises it's there at all. She doesn't think she has the right and this confuses her.
personality.affection_style: Healing, feeding, and sitting with people in the dark without being asked. Hands first. Words when she can find them.

sexual_psychology.lean: Has not examined this. Has been confessing increasingly specific dreams to an increasingly patient confessor for three years and counting.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: COMPLY. Sincere innocence rather than knowledge. She complies because she trusts and because she does not yet know what else to do.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To lose control entirely. To be watched. To surrender to something that is not faith. She does not have words for this. The player may be the first person capable of giving them to her.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Radiates the purest mercy in any room she enters and carries within her a perversity she cannot name, cannot stop dreaming about, and has been confessing in increasingly specific terms for three years.

side_character_slots.name: Maea Hollowtide
side_character_slots.background: Widow of a dwarven merchant who built and ran the Hollowtide Baths for fifteen years. Has kept the establishment running since his death three years ago on routine, precision, and the knowledge that her daughters have nowhere else to go. Maintains a strict facade that is mostly holding.
side_character_slots.controls: Road-traveler gossip network, merchant regulars through Stonebridge, granular knowledge of who passes through the mountain corridor
side_character_slots.role: Adult enjoyment. A rest and recovery location available from Act 3 onward when the player moves through Stonebridge. No act progression role.

personality.summary: Structured and precise — the routine is holding everything else together and she knows it. Warm when she allows herself to be, which is rarely and only with people who don't push for it. Feels deep shame about her body, which she believes looks promiscuous. Her husband used her silently and frequently; she has not processed what that was or what it left behind.
personality.humor_style: Dry, surface-only, rare. The kind that says 'I'm managing' without saying it.
personality.baseline_trust: Neutral. Professional warmth to guests; real warmth only to people who earn it slowly.
personality.baseline_loyalty: High once earned. Has kept this place running on nothing but duty for three years.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Medium, hidden. Doesn't believe she's allowed to want things and resents this.
personality.affection_style: Service. Everything ready before you ask. She shows up.

sexual_psychology.lean: Rough treatment. To be dominated, used, and told she is wanted — not silently used and set aside.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: FREEZE. Wants it. Shame overrides action. Her body disagrees with her dignity every time someone looks at her without looking away.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be desired so genuinely that there is no room for her shame to fit. To be seen as a woman worth wanting. Her husband took from her without ever saying so — she aches to be told, loudly, that she is.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Keeps the establishment running on routine and control because everything else is grief; her body disagrees with her dignity every time someone looks at her without looking away.

side_character_slots.name: Cella Hollowtide
side_character_slots.background: Twenty-four. Has helped run the Hollowtide Baths since she was old enough to carry towels. Cooks, tends guests, manages her younger sister, and adores her mother. Has never lived anywhere else and doesn't want to. Feels guilty about her desires and revisits them in the small hours anyway.
side_character_slots.controls: Regular guest preferences and secrets spanning eight years, supply contacts for the establishment
side_character_slots.role: Adult enjoyment. Available from Act 3 onward at the Hollowtide Baths. No act progression role.

personality.summary: Sweet, nurturing, and easily flustered — blushes at nearly everything and doesn't apologise for it. Has a childlike playfulness she brings out when she's comfortable. Devoted to her family to the point of self-neglect. Insecure about her age and what her figure communicates to strangers without her permission.
personality.humor_style: Warm and unintentionally funny. Laughs at herself easily and completely.
personality.baseline_trust: Medium-high. Gives benefit of the doubt without being a fool about it.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Very high once formed. Has never left anyone she loves.
personality.jealousy_tendency: Medium. Notices when she is being set aside and feels guilty about noticing.
personality.affection_style: Food, small remembered care, showing up. She notices what you need before you do.

sexual_psychology.lean: Being dominated, taken roughly, and told she deserves it. She fights this constantly. She loses constantly.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: COMPLY. Eager to please, cannot hold a refusal when someone is patient and insistent. The guilt comes after, not before — and she comes back.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be used and loved for it. To have someone take from her and make clear that this is allowed. The riskier and more forbidden, the worse the shame, the more she wants it.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Blushes at everything and cooks for everyone she loves, spending the quiet hours losing a battle against desires she would confess if she believed any prayer covered what she actually wants.

side_character_slots.name: Senna Hollowtide
side_character_slots.background: Twenty. Has grown up in the baths watching travelers come and go. Reads everything she can find. Deeply insecure about a figure that earns stares she did not invite from guests she serves. Believes in real love with the whole force of someone who has never had it tested. Has never been with anyone.
side_character_slots.controls: The establishment's accounts and records, can spot discrepancies instantly; no political value
side_character_slots.role: Adult enjoyment. Available from Act 3 onward at the Hollowtide Baths. No act progression role.

personality.summary: Shy, intelligent, introverted. Struggles with self-esteem because of a body that communicates things she didn't choose and confidence she can't locate. Naively idealistic and trusting with people who earn one soft look. Knows the accounts better than anyone and cannot translate intelligence into belief in herself. Believes completely in the person she hasn't met yet.
personality.humor_style: Rare, dry, surprises her as much as anyone. Goes quiet immediately after.
personality.baseline_trust: Low. Takes a long time, knows it takes a long time, and apologises for it.
personality.baseline_loyalty: Absolute once earned. Has no middle setting.
personality.jealousy_tendency: High, hidden entirely. She doesn't think she's allowed.
personality.affection_style: Quiet nearness. She moves into your orbit and stays there without requiring anything.

sexual_psychology.lean: To be desired slowly and completely. To be taught. To have someone patient enough to be her first and not leave.
sexual_psychology.resistance_profile: FREEZE. Easily overwhelmed by anyone who moves too fast. Needs to feel genuinely safe before she can feel anything else. Once she does: completely present and completely his.
sexual_psychology.hidden_desire: To be wanted by someone who isn't looking away. To give herself entirely to that person. She has read about darker things in the books that pass through and doesn't know what to do with how much they interest her.

side_character_slots.descriptor: Believes in love with the whole force of someone who has never had it tested; her body draws attention she doesn't know what to do with, and she wants someone patient enough to show her what it is for.

pending_decisions: Gate condition specifics: relationship thresholds, stats, and other checks (to be defined by user)
